question: How many weeks ago did I attend a bird watching workshop at the local Audubon society?

gold_sessions.user_turns:
[turn 0] I'm planning a trip to the nearby wildlife refuge this weekend and I'm wondering if you can give me some info on what birds I might see this time of year. By the way, I just got back from a bird watching workshop at the local Audubon society today, which was really informative.

[turn 2] It's located in the southeast region, and it's currently spring. I'm planning to explore the wetlands and forests areas, as I've heard they're good spots for spotting waterfowl and songbirds.

[turn 4] I'm really hoping to spot some warblers, as I've been trying to add more of them to my life list. Do you think the Yellow Warblers I saw on my guided bird walk a month and a half ago might still be around, or have they already moved on to their breeding grounds?

[turn 6] I've been meaning to try out the Merlin Bird ID app that Sarah recommended at the workshop today, do you think it would be helpful in identifying warblers?

[turn 8] I'm wondering if Merlin can also help with bird calls and songs, as I've been trying to improve my skills in identifying birds by their songs.

[turn 10] I'm planning to focus on the wetlands area first, as I've heard that's where the warblers tend to congregate during migration. Do you think the Merlin app would be able to help me identify any warblers I might spot in the wetlands?
